title: Nine Pounds and One Dance
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：benefit　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 benefit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 my aunt organised ① a benefit for a family she had never spoken to, and my mother said the not speaking was the whole of the kindness. The ② benefit, meaning the event and not the money, raised nine pounds and was discussed for eleven years; a benefit, she said, is the only kindness that is counted out loud.

Every ③ benefit in that street was held in the same hall, and the ④ benefit in March, meaning the one for the widow and not either of those, was the only one anybody gave twice to. A benefit, my grandmother said, is nine parts obligation and one part somebody willing to organise; my aunt said the obligation is the part that shows.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ benefit was the whole of the medicine, meaning the good it did and not the event. The ⑥ benefit, meaning the advantage and not any of that, is the only thing in a cure that nobody can see and everybody claims; a benefit, he said, is either something you organise or the only word that means both a dance and an advantage. She said the advantage is the part they argue about.

By 1964 the ⑦ benefit had become a photograph in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about how much had been raised. The ⑧ benefit of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in June, was nine pounds and eleven years of discussion; a benefit, she said, is either the dance in the hall or the reason you know your neighbours. He said the knowing was the part that lasted.

The ⑨ benefit I remember is the one in March, which raised nine pounds and cost eleven. A ⑩ benefit, my grandmother said in 1967, is the only kindness that improves by being counted; every benefit, she said, is an advantage that has agreed to look like a dance. She said the advantage was never in the hall.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 义演；慈善募捐活动
B. n. 义演（指那场活动，与钱相对）
C. 固定搭配：organise a benefit 组织一场义演／募捐活动
D. n. 义演（指那条街上每一场）
E. n. 义演（指三月那一场）
F. n. 益处；好处（指那味药的效用）
G. n. 益处（抽象：那种好处)
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a benefit for a family she had never spoken to
The benefit, meaning the event and not the money
benefit was the whole of the medicine
the benefit had become a photograph in a paper
The benefit of the whole thing
A benefit, my grandmother said in 1967

answers.why: organise a benefit 意为“组织一场义演／募捐活动”，1950 年姑姑为一户她从没说过话的人家组织了一场义演。
benefit 意为“义演”，指那场活动而不是钱，它筹到九镑，却被人讨论了十一年。
benefit 指那条街上每一场义演，每一场都在同一个礼堂办。
benefit 指三月那一场（为那位寡妇办的那一场），是唯一有人捐过两次的。
benefit 意为“益处、好处”，指那味药的效用，父亲说 benefit 就是那味药的全部。
benefit 为抽象用法，指那种好处，是一次治疗里没人看得见、却人人都声称有的东西。
benefit 意为“义演”，到 1964 年这个 benefit 成了报纸上的一张照片。
benefit 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，姑姑六月写道，整件事权衡下来是九镑和十一年的议论。
benefit 意为“义演”，我记得的是三月那一场，它筹到九镑，却花了十一镑。
benefit 为抽象总称，祖母说善举是唯一会因为被算清楚而变好的东西。
